title: Implementer result tool contract
description: CME v3.0 §2.T5 — input_schema for the report_implementer tool forced via tool_choice. Models the structured result written by a Implementer subagent after completing (DONE) or escalating (ESCALATE) its assigned task.

status.description: DONE when the task is fully implemented and verified; ESCALATE when blocked.

summary.description: <=3 sentences — what was done or why escalation is needed.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of non-test source files written or modified.

files_test_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of test files written or modified.

commit.description: Short commit SHA if a commit was made, else omit.

method_audit.description: TDD compliance audit; omit for ESCALATE results.

tdd.description: applied when red/green cycle ran; waived with a waive_reason.

red_command.description: Command that produced the failing test(s) before implementation.

green_command.description: Command that produced a passing suite after implementation.

key_decision.description: One notable design or trade-off decision worth surfacing to the reviewer.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence — error output, file path, conflicting spec lines.

question.description: Specific question for the orchestrator to resolve.
